The 7-day 424/424 win rate is real but narrow: three coins, thin 1.4% ROI, and the same wallet lost $4.75M over 30 days on SOL/XRP with 53.9% win rate. A one-week hot streak after a blowup is not a durable edge. I'm sizing small, not zero, because the streak is genuine evidence.

shots.text: PONS returned +$100,849 over the 30 days. A 1% probe costs $250 and buys you next month of data. Zero buys you nothing.
shots.line: PONS is real, but the SOL/XRP blowup still governs; small probe, tight leash.

PONS +$100,849 with 727/727 wins over 30 days is the one genuinely clean book here — but the same wallet's $4.47M SOL loss still stands against it. The pitch's 1% framing undersells nothing, yet a $250 probe is too small to matter. I'll scale up modestly from my prior.
